name: maikelsoft-skills
description: Skills and agents by Maikel. Each skill writes clear output: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, or Begrijpelijk Nederlands (B1).

plugins.name: dev-docs
plugins.description: Write, rewrite, and review developer documentation: README, tutorial, how-to, reference, explanation, ADR, changelog, code comments, and UI text.

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Builds one approved work item (story, bug, task, or chore) from the tracker to tested commits. Sets a tier from the size and the risk of the change (patch, small, medium, large) and runs only the steps and gates of that tier. Product questions go back to the product owner on the item.

plugins.name: dev-build
plugins.description: Build good agent skills and agents: research, concept, test, build. Skills build-skill and build-agent, with checkers. Agents for Claude Code, the Agent SDK, Managed Agents, and OpenClaw.

plugins.name: product-flow
plugins.description: Take a product idea to an approved backlog: research, questions, a prototype with your branding, a spec with a story map, and goals, epics, features, and user stories in your ticket system. For product owners and business analysts.

plugins.name: dev-stack
plugins.description: Stack skills for a .NET 10 team: C#, ASP.NET Core, OpenAPI, validation, EF Core, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MSTest 4, analyzers, observability, Redis, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, Wolverine, MailKit, PuppeteerSharp, secure coding, and the move to AwesomeAssertions. Version-specific rules, a check step with a tool, and one report format.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: A small developer team for one large or risky work item: a senior designs and builds the core, mediors build work packages, a security reviewer checks the diff, and the main session leads with two human gates. dev-flow starts it for a large item. Needs dev-stack. Preview.

plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: A UX designer agent and its practice skills: problem frame, flow, pattern rules, design spec with a source for each decision, states, design-system audit, and mockups.
